notes.title: Ukrainian localization is here!
notes.notes:
After a few busy months of translating and coding we are proud to present ukrainian language. Made with love and as close to the experience we had in mind when we first wrote this story, as it could've been. We hope you enjoy it.

[b]Warning for the returning players[/b]: due to some engine restrictions, your old same files might not work, so you'd have to start from scratch.
